description: Read-only. The app setup Strait has for this workspace (GET /v1/app): Android package name, SHA-256 signing fingerprints and scheme; iPhone Team ID, bundle ID and App ID; each link domain with its assetlinks.json and apple-app-site-association URL and whether the scheduled check found it served (null = not checked yet); per platform (android, ios, web) the newest app open and the Strait SDK version it sent. Compare it with the app's own files (applicationId, signing key, bundle ID, associated domains) before editing code. App details are changed by a person in Dashboard → Apps & stores (also Setup › Your apps, setupUrl). Then run verify_app_setup. Needs a read or full secret key.
name: get_app_setup
title: Read the app setup
